description: Compile real customer language into a typed Intent IR, answer it from the evidence-gated market store with honest unknowns, and expose merchant-actionable opportunity from the same evidence.
real_outcome: REAL USER INTENT -> USEFUL EVIDENCE-GATED ANSWER -> MERCHANT OPPORTUNITY
reversibility: Answers are reads; bounded public observations are pseudonymously deduplicated and throttled; emitted opportunities are dismissable records; follow-up triggers expire by construction.

canonical_actions.description: Answer a customer intent from verified market truth
Compile raw language to Intent IR (deterministic, unknowns explicit)
Re-evaluate one tenant-scoped MARKET_GAP against the same current truth gate; close only after a verified candidate exists

evidence_hooks: one AskIntentSignal row per admitted public observation (SHA-256 intent identity + minimized raw-free IR + answer summary)
one tenant-scoped semantically deduplicated Opportunity row (verification UNKNOWN) when the evidence exposes a MARKET_GAP or CAPABILITY_GAP
candidate provenance object per answer (same shape as /api/v1/retailers)
continuation_hooks: atomically creates one FOLLOW_UP trigger (OBSERVE_ONLY, budgeted, stop-conditioned, 7d expiry, bounded 24h recurrence) per admitted opportunity; the registered ask_market_gap_recheck consumer appends REFLECTED and closes only on current verified candidates
backend_adapters: deterministic-lexicon-v1 (a model-backed compiler may compete as a challenger behind the same IR contract)
